summary: The retrieval evidence identifies baseline clinical and genomic variables in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including tumor mutational burden (TMB), performance status (ECOG), and specific genetic mutations (e.g., KRAS G12C, STK11 loss). TMB is specifically highlighted as an indicator of the potential benefit from PD-1/PD-L1 checkpoint blockade.
